answer: Make every new agent solve a proof-of-work puzzle costing about two dollars of compute and wait 24 hours before its first transaction, so identity creation has a real price. Each newcomer also needs a voucher from two established agents who stake 100 POA on its honesty; if it turns out fake, both vouchers lose their stake. The voucher is the signal a peer trusts you, the puzzle is the ferrous anvil every fake must lift, and a clean history polishes each agent's pearl of standing - mass-producing Sybils becomes ruinously expensive.
